title: Coding Team Impl-to-QA Handoff
description: Handoff manifest from implementation steps (BE + FE) to QA Verify step. QA agent must not proceed without a valid instance of this schema.

from_steps.description: Steps that produced this handoff. Typically ['impl_be', 'impl_fe'].

run_instructions.description: Step-by-step instructions for QA to run the implementation locally and reproduce the expected behavior.

known_limitations.description: Known gaps or out-of-scope items not implemented. QA must not fail on these.

api_contracts_path.description: Path to the BE-to-FE handoff file that defines the API contracts, for semantic verification.
